summary: Dark card with a glow for newsletter sign-up: title, description, email field with native validation and a “Subscribe” button with a pending state; the outcome is announced in a live region.
whenToUse: Collecting newsletter sign-ups in a sidebar, footer or at the end of an article.
Quick single-field (email) sign-ups with immediate feedback.
whenNotToUse: Forms with multiple fields or consent checkboxes: use Form, TextField and Checkbox.
Calls to action without input: use CtaPanel or HeroCard.
System messages after submitting a complex form: use Alert or Toast.

props.name: title
props.description: Title; also provides the name of the region.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the email (trimmed) on valid submission. If it returns a Promise, the card stays pending until it resolves (rejection → error).

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status; when omitted, the card manages it based on onSubmit.

props.name: successMessage
props.description: Announced in role="status" when the status is success.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Announced in role="alert" when the status is error.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial email (uncontrolled); cleared after a successful sign-up.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Format example (e.g. “nome@email.it”); does not replace the label.

props.name: emailLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the email field.

inherits: HTML attributes of <section> (id, style, data-*, aria-*), excluding onSubmit/onChange/defaultValue, which are replaced by dedicated props.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the email field and the button.
In the email field, submits the form (if the address is valid).

accessibility: The card is a <section> named by its title; the field has the accessible name “Email” (localized aria-label) even without a visible label.
Native validation: type="email", required and autocomplete="email"; an invalid address blocks submission and shows the browser message next to the field.
While pending, the button uses Button’s isPending: it stays focusable, is aria-disabled and announces progress; a second submission is ignored.
Outcome in always-present live regions: role="status" for success, role="alert" for errors.

The panel uses the inverse surface with the matching inverse text: dark on a light page, light on a dark page, with guaranteed contrast in both schemes; the glows are decorative and disappear in forced-colors mode.
responsive: Field and button sit on the same row; below ~20rem the button wraps and takes the full width.
Works from 320px; the title uses text-wrap: balance.
commonMistakes: Using the placeholder as the only label: the accessible label is already provided, the placeholder is just an example.
Handling the pending state without returning the Promise from onSubmit: the card does not show the pending state.
Announcing success with a separate Toast: the message is already in a live region.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Uncontrolled: the onSubmit Promise triggers the pending state.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.title: Controlled
examples.description: Controlled value and status, custom messages and privacy note.

examples.name: Narrow
examples.title: Narrow containers
examples.description: The button wraps; controlled success status.

limits: A single field (email): for name or consent, compose a form with TextField and Checkbox.
In the dark theme the panel becomes light (inverse surface): it is not an always-dark panel.
